Definition: an offence (sometimes habitual sinfulness), and its penalty, occasion, sacrifice, or expiation; also (concretely) an offender
BiblicalUsage: 1) sin, sinful; 2) sin, sin offering; 2a) sin; 2b) condition of sin, guilt of sin; 2c) punishment for sin; 2d) sin-offering; 2e) purification from sins of ceremonial uncleanness
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
